title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 12: Jerusalem as a cup of reeling and a burdensome stone, and the great mourning in the city.

questions.text: In the opening verse, what does Yahweh form within man?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:1 says Yahweh stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him.

questions.text: What will Yahweh make Jerusalem for all the surrounding peoples?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:2 says Yahweh will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples.

questions.text: What will happen to all who burden themselves with Jerusalem, the burdensome stone?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:3 says all who burden themselves with Jerusalem will be severely wounded.

answers.text: They will grow rich from her
They will be scattered among the nations

questions.text: What will Yahweh strike the horses of the peoples with?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:4 says Yahweh will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

questions.text: What will Yahweh make the chieftains of Judah like in that day?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:6 says he will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood and like a flaming torch among sheaves.

answers.text: Like a shepherd with his flock
Like a strong tower in the field
Like a pan of fire among wood

questions.text: Whose tents will Yahweh save first?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:7 says Yahweh will save the tents of Judah first.

questions.text: What is said of the one who is feeble in Jerusalem in that day?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:8 says that he who is feeble among them at that day will be like David.

answers.text: He will be healed of every sickness
He will be made a priest
He will be carried out of the city

questions.text: How will they mourn for the one they have pierced?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:10 says they will mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and grieve bitterly as one grieves for his firstborn.

answers.text: As a nation mourns a lost battle
As one mourns for an only son
As a widow mourns her husband
As a servant mourns his master

questions.text: The great mourning in Jerusalem is compared to the mourning of which place?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:11 compares it to the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

answers.text: Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon
Ramah in the land of Benjamin

questions.text: Which families are named as mourning, each one apart?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 12:12-13 names the family of David's house, the family of the house of Nathan, the family of the house of Levi and the family of the Shimeites, each apart with their wives apart.

answers.text: The families of Reuben, Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh
The families of Korah, Asaph, Heman and the Kohathites
David's house, the house of Nathan, the house of Levi and the Shimeites
The houses of Saul, Jonathan, Absalom and Solomon
